summary: MineralRite Corp filed an 8-K disclosing a private transaction between two existing securityholders: Abstract Concepts 1618 LLC agreed to acquire 6.9 million shares of Series NMC Convertible Preferred Stock and associated warrants from NMC, Inc. The company is not a party. No new securities are issued. Specific economic terms were not disclosed. Post-transaction, Abstract will beneficially own ~37% of common stock on a converted basis. The company entered a Shareholder Control Limitation and Standstill Agreement capping Abstract's voting power at 45% and prohibiting control attempts. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for any future proxy contests or triggering events that could alter the standstill.
